What is the secret ingredient?

A Service Learning Network

Training and service are inseparable. Doulas learn by doing, with real clients, real births, real impact.

A Standardized Care Model

Every client receives the same standard of care every time, documented, measured, and proven.

The Service Learning Network

For our clients

Doula services are not free. They are sponsored by our doula learners and volunteers. Every client receives professional, trained support at no cost to them.

For our doulas

Training is not free. It is a scholarship. In exchange, doulas serve on 2 client teams per year for 2 years, gaining their first 3 birth experiences in a supported network environment.

Upon completion doulas are eligible for certification exams and to join Louisiana's doula reimbursement registry, ready for autonomous or collective doula work.

Right now there is a person in your community who is pregnant and scared. She does not have a doula. She cannot afford one. And she does not know a community could build one for her.

You can change that.
Here is exactly how.

How it works.

Get started

Location. Food. Funding through grants, MCOs, hospitals, and local partners.

Build your pipeline

Partner with a birthing hospital. Clients move through the field guide from intake to postpartum. Data collects itself.

It sustains itself

Word of mouth fills the client list. One training per quarter keeps up with demand. The community takes over.

The infrastructure is already built. You just have to say yes.
